title: Scholarship for International Students of TUM
summary: Semester support for enrolled international TUM students with good academic results and demonstrated financial need.

degree_levels.notes: Not specified in the collected source.

subject_areas.notes: Not specified in the collected source.

institutions.notes: Not specified in the collected source.

nationality.notes: Applicants must be ineligible for BAföG because of their nationality; this is a legal eligibility test rather than a simple non-German nationality rule.

residence.notes: Requires enrolment at TUM and a residence permit among the application documents.

mandatory.text: Bachelor's students must be in at least their third semester; Master's students normally at least their second semester.
First-semester Master's applicants are eligible if their Bachelor's degree was completed at TUM.
Good academic results and proven financial need, including the applicant's, parents' and where applicable spouse's income.
Thesis submission must not be before 30 June for the summer term or 31 December for the winter term.
The scholarship is not paid during a leave of absence.

funding.description: One-off aid of EUR 500–1,800 per semester; students may reapply each semester. Waivers and waiver scholarships count as income in the need assessment.
funding.duration: Reapplication each semester; maximum total funding period 36 months.

application_rounds.notes: Grade reports and recommendations have a separate supplementary deadline of 15 November; this does not extend the application deadline.

required_documents.text: Motivation letter explaining finances in 100–200 words, in English or German
Two recommendations no older than one semester
Income evidence and statements for every bank account covering the preceding 12 months
Parents' and, if applicable, spouse's income evidence; certified German translations where required
Where applicable, children's birth certificates, spouse's registration and other income-related documents

steps.text: Submit the online application within the stated period.
Provide grade reports and recommendations by the stated supplementary deadline.
